title: PROMPT_3_V2_LINE_LEVEL_WAVE3_INTEGRATION
universal_lens: Wave 3 defines a constrained document-generation system: 11 strategic lanes span a capability space; 9 hard constraints carve a feasible polytope; 14 required docs × 14 mandatory sections form a rank-196 requirement tensor; dual operators (Claude/Codex) with audit commutator enforce schema integrity; autonomous continuation provides a deterministic transition function on blockage states.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats each strategic lane as a Bayesian evidence channel with constraint-induced priors; the requirement tensor defines a conformal prediction set for doc completeness; Codex audit acts as a calibration operator ensuring coverage validity; hard constraints implement hard vetoes in the inference graph preventing unsupported claims.
gse_mapping: GSE models the system as a state-transition machine: states = {blocked_on_code, blocked_on_docs, blocked_on_audit, handoff}; transitions = autonomous continuation rules; operators = {Claude_write, Codex_audit, Human_approve}; the constraint manifold defines absorbing failure states; doc schema defines emission alphabets for each lane.

primitives.name: Strategic Lane Capability Basis
primitives.verbatim_quote: Wave 3 adds the following strategic lanes: Player Performance Intelligence, Baseball Biomechanics Intelligence, Sports Science Evidence Vault, Radar/Tracking Data Layer, Force Plate and High-Performance Layer, Video Play Classification Layer, Sports API Provider Modules, Model Benchmark Lab, RAG Governance, Product/System Design Maturity, and Motion/Transition Doctrine.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: L_i ∈ {1..11} lane index; dim = 11 (dimensionless); each lane orthogonal in capability space; no SI units.
primitives.assumptions: Lanes are mutually exclusive capability dimensions; completeness requires spanning all 11; no lane subsumes another.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Collinearity when two lanes share >80% source evidence; singularity when a lane has zero high-signal line references in audit.

layer2.mapping: GSI: each lane = evidence channel with independent likelihood; GSE: each lane = state variable in situational reasoning; constraint manifold restricts joint support.
layer2.telemetry: Lane coverage ratio = (lanes with ≥1 high-signal ref) / 11; target = 1.0

primitives.name: Hard Constraint Feasible Polytope
primitives.verbatim_quote: Hard constraints: no Sports repo rebuild, no route rename, no schema change, no dependency change, no public Brain, no crawler implementation, no commercial use of OBP/Driveline data without written commercial license, no prompt-leak reproduction, no auth bypass copying, no unsupported public claims.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C_j ∈ {1..9} constraint index; feasible set F = {x ∈ ℝ^11 | ∀j: C_j(x) = 0}; dimensionless; indicator constraints.
primitives.assumptions: Constraints are hard boundaries (not soft penalties); jointly satisfiable; independent (no logical redundancy).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Infeasibility when constraint intersection = ∅; over-constraint when rank(Jacobian) > 11; license constraint creates non-convex feasible region.

layer2.mapping: GSI: constraints = zero-probability regions in prior; GSE: constraints = forbidden transitions in state machine; license constraint creates absorbing legal-risk state.
layer2.telemetry: Constraint violation count = Σ_j 1[C_j violated]; target = 0; license clearance boolean per data source.

primitives.name: Document Requirement Tensor
primitives.verbatim_quote: Required first docs: docs/performance/player-performance-intelligence.md, sports-science-evidence-vault.md, biomechanics-modality-taxonomy.md, radar-and-tracking-data-layer.md, force-plate-and-high-performance-layer.md, play-classification-layer.md, sports-science-licensing-policy.md, docs/models/model-benchmark-lab.md, ragflow-governance.md, prompt-leak-and-auth-sensitive-policy.md, docs/data/source-provider-module-taxonomy.md, sports-api-provider-policy.md, docs/design/component-system-maturity.md, motion-and-transition-doctrine.md.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: D_k ∈ {1..14} doc index; S_m ∈ {1..14} section index; R_{k,m} ∈ {0,1} requirement tensor; 196 binary entries; dimensionless.
primitives.assumptions: All 14 sections mandatory for all 14 docs (per quote 10); tensor is fully dense (no optional sections); each doc maps to ≥1 strategic lane.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Rank deficiency when docs share identical section content; singularity when a doc has zero source evidence lines for a required section.

layer2.mapping: GSI: R defines conformal prediction set for doc completeness; GSE: each (doc,section) = emission symbol; tensor factorization reveals latent lane-section coupling.
layer2.telemetry: Section completion rate = (1/196) Σ_{k,m} 1[section m of doc k drafted]; target = 1.0; evidence density = lines_ref / section.

primitives.name: Blockage-State Transition Function
primitives.verbatim_quote: Continue autonomously: if blocked on code, write docs; if blocked on docs, audit; if blocked on audit, create handoff.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: State s ∈ {B_code, B_docs, B_audit, Handoff}; Transition T: S → S; T(B_code)=B_docs, T(B_docs)=B_audit, T(B_audit)=Handoff; dimensionless; deterministic.
primitives.assumptions: Exactly one blockage type active at a time; transitions are memoryless; Handoff is absorbing (requires human).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Livelock if T cycles (not possible with given rules); deadlock if multiple simultaneous blockages; Handoff failure if no human receiver.

layer2.mapping: GSI: protocol = fallback policy ensuring evidence production continues; GSE: defines operator scheduling under resource constraints; Codex audit = verification transition.
layer2.telemetry: Mean time to Handoff from any blockage; blockage frequency per lane; docs-written-per-code-blockage ratio.
